_meta.reference: LA IATSE and Basic Crafts local wage schedules, extracted from archived AMPTP documents.
_meta.schema_note: A row carries `rates`, an array of {col, header, value}, and no `value`. Rows are keyed on (local, occ, work_relation) and NOT on a wage schedule number — the number is a document-local ordinal and the Basic Crafts documents print none. `work_relation`, `production_type` and `rate_variant` are derived from each schedule's own descriptor, which is carried on the row so the selection can be audited against the source.
_meta.scope: FEATURES ONLY (Brian, 7 Sep 2026). production_type=general, rate_variant=full. The High Budget SVOD schedules (-7.10%, and -15.83% on the Local 44 on-call lines), the one-half hour prime time television schedules, the 3% reduction and one-year lag variants, and the ICG Local 600 Amendment territories are all extracted and present in canon_cells.v2.csv. They are not emitted here. Widening is a change to SELECT.
_meta.resolution_path: Not reached by `global`. rateCanon.js findLaEntry() matches on local + occ + work relation; findCanonEntry(global) serves only the DGA/WGA/SAG/ASA rows.
_meta.sources_modified_at_note: null, deliberately: these rows come from archived AMPTP PDFs, not a Drive canon, so there is no modifiedTime. Each document's SHA-256 is in la_sources, a stronger detector.
_meta.schedule_conflicts_note: More than one schedule satisfied the selection for these (local, work relation) pairs, so nothing was emitted for them. Merging would blend columns from two agreements into one row.
